deviations_and_clarifications: The v1 pipeline (engine_score) is imported unchanged; features of the 17 v1 diseases are recomputed from the same caches.
Gold 3 and union analyses keep only diseases with a non-empty gold; this is a clarification, v1 had no empty gold 1.
Proxy baseline mechanism terms: v1 diseases use the v1 benchmark matched_terms; new diseases use the narrow v1 rule on the cached UniProt annotation plus gene symbols.
Europe PMC POST is used for gene queries longer than 1500 characters (same endpoint, same parameters).
The 'common disease' exclusion and the per-class AUC table are post hoc/descriptive and change no decision.
The temporal analysis for the v2 corrected gold 2 has no pre-registered threshold; it is descriptive.

gold_definitions.gold1: universe drug with a PrimeKG `indication` edge to the disease (unchanged from v1)
gold_definitions.gold2: universe drug that is an intervention of an EXPERIMENTAL arm group of an interventional ClinicalTrials.gov study of the disease, phase 2 or later, start date after 2018-12-31
gold_definitions.gold3: universe drug whose current FDA label (openFDA indications_and_usage, up to 5 most recent labels) contains the disease name or an exact synonym as a whole phrase (case-insensitive, no negation handling)

gold_handling: Gold 1 is the endpoint gold. For gold 3 and the union a disease enters an analysis only if that gold is non-empty (diseases_excluded_empty_gold lists the others); the cross-validation uses the same diseases.
known_limits: Gold 1 is incomplete and partly circular; gold 3 is a text match without negation handling.
Several new diseases are common or non-rare (multi-subtype umbrella terms); see the post hoc sensitivity analysis.
Bootstrap intervals are disease-level; small subsets (held-out, non-empty gold 3) give wide intervals.

sensitivity_excluding_common_diseases_po.rule: Post hoc sensitivity (not pre-registered). Rule S1 = the five diseases named in the v2 hand-back (small cell lung carcinoma, ovarian cancer, systemic lupus erythematosus, Parkinson disease, Alzheimer disease). Rule S2 = S1 plus every disease of the v2 file whose Orphanet/HPO inheritance annotation contains a complex-disease mode (Non-Mendelian, Polygenic, Multigenic/multifactorial). 'Sporadic' alone does not flag a disease. The v2 file itself carries no 'common' flag.
